title: Bueeld Hackathon Decision Loop
description: Schema describing a single iteration of the Bueeld decision loop: the facts driving the decision, the risky assumption being tested, the candidate options, the recommended experiment to validate the assumption, human approval status, the observed result, and the resulting reassessment.

facts.description: Known, verified facts informing the current decision.

riskyAssumption.description: The single riskiest assumption underlying the decision.

statement.description: The assumption being made, stated as a testable claim.

impactIfWrong.description: Consequence to the plan if this assumption turns out to be false.

confidence.description: Current confidence level that the assumption is true.

options.description: The two candidate options being weighed.

recommendedExperiment.description: The smallest experiment recommended to validate the risky assumption before committing.

metric.description: The measurable signal the experiment will produce.

threshold.description: The pass/fail bar for the metric that determines the outcome of the experiment.

estimatedDuration.description: Rough time needed to run the experiment.

humanApproval.description: Human sign-off on running the recommended experiment or acting on its result.

approver.description: Name or identifier of the person approving/rejecting.

notes.description: Any comments accompanying the approval decision.

timestamp.description: When the approval decision was recorded.

observedResult.description: The actual outcome measured after running the experiment.

metricValue.description: The measured value of the experiment's metric.

metThreshold.description: Whether the observed metric value met the defined threshold.

summary.description: Narrative summary of what was observed.

reassessment.description: Updated understanding and next decision after reviewing the observed result.

updatedConfidence.description: Revised confidence in the risky assumption after the experiment.

chosenOption.description: Name of the option selected based on the result.

rationale.description: Why this option was chosen given the observed result.

nextSteps.description: Follow-up actions resulting from this decision loop iteration.
